about: Provenance for the bundled snapshot in this directory. Every other .json file here is the raw response body of the named codetopo-server API endpoint, saved byte-for-byte as returned by a real run — no values were edited, recomputed, or invented.
analyzed_tree: A clean copy of the source tree at source_commit (build output excluded; the indexer saw exactly the repository's source files).
cross_checks_at_capture: snapshot.json node/edge counts equal stats.json totals (2544 / 7131).
snapshot.json audit_head equals verify.json head; verify.json chain_valid is true.

Descendants/ancestors totals computed from snapshot.json (transitive closures over calls+imports edges) matched the server's /descendants and /ancestors endpoints for every sampled node (14 of 14 checks).
tool_source: Built with cargo from the same source_commit (cargo build --release -p codetopo-server).
